name: Milanote
description: Milanote is a visual workspace for organizing creative projects, research, ideas, and inspiration. People use flexible boards to combine notes, images, links, files, tasks, sketches, and comments while planning and reviewing work with collaborators.
agentUseSummary: Milanote cannot be connected to agents through Relay's public Marketplace because Milanote publishes no supported account API, delegated OAuth contract, or remote MCP service, and its terms reserve back-end access for written agreements.

blocked.label: Connect a Milanote account
blocked.description: Milanote does not publish a supported OAuth, API-key, or remote MCP connection contract for public third-party applications.

blocked.label: Use Milanote account data
blocked.description: Milanote does not publish the authentication method, endpoints, schemas, permissions, or rate limits needed to read or change a customer's boards through a supported account API.

blocked.label: Run Milanote agent actions
blocked.description: Relay Console cannot reverse engineer Milanote or mount its private application interface as agent tools.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a distributable Milanote integration agreement and supported technical contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No documented public Milanote account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No documented public Milanote account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Milanote publishes no developer program, account API, delegated OAuth contract, or remote MCP service, while its terms state that back-end access requires an express written agreement and prohibit reverse engineering.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider Milanote only if the provider grants Relay Console a distributable written integration agreement with current documentation and supported credentials.

evidence.supports: Milanote describes a visual workspace for creative projects that combines notes, images, videos, sketches, web research, project organization, and collaboration.
Milanote's official help center documents product use, content, sharing, apps, web clippers, plans, and troubleshooting but exposes no developer or account-API section.
Milanote states that its OAuth support is for signing users into Milanote through Apple and Google; it does not document delegated third-party access to Milanote accounts.

Milanote's terms state that no back-end access is available unless expressly agreed in writing and prohibit copying, decompiling, reverse engineering, or otherwise obtaining its application architecture, algorithms, or code.
Milanote documents manual board export to PDF, PNG, Word, Markdown, plain text, and ZIP rather than a supported programmatic account interface.
